title: Ice Hockey Rinks and Spatial Heatmaps for ggplot2
text: annotate_rink() adds markings, fixed-aspect coordinate system theme. Map data plain rink coordinates: metres bottom-left corner boards, x along length.  data works vertical rink, cropped offensive zone. Pass dimensions = NHL North American rink:
code: library(ggplot2) library(gghockey)  ggplot(shots, aes(x, y)) +   annotate_rink(details = TRUE) +   geom_point(aes(colour = factor(goal)), alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c("0" = "grey50", "1" = "#C8102E"),                       labels = c("No goal", "Goal"), name = NULL) +   labs(title = "1,500 simulated shots") library(patchwork)  oz <- ggplot(shots, aes(x, y)) +   annotate_rink(orientation = "vertical", zones = "oz", details = TRUE) +   geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8, colour = "#143F84") +   labs(title = "IIHF, offensive zone") +   theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13))  nhl <- ggplot() +   annotate_rink(dimensions = NHL, colour = "grey25", fill = "white", details = TRUE) +   labs(title = "NHL, full rink") +   theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13))  oz + nhl + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2))

title: Ice Hockey Rinks and Spatial Heatmaps for ggplot2
text: geom_rink_bin() bins events square grid averages z cell. Pick style fits story; matching scales attached .  "size", area square proportional number shots colour mean xG. Squares drawn rink units never get bigger one cell, can’t overlap.
code: heatmap <- function(style, ...) {   ggplot(shots, aes(x, y, z = xg)) +     annotate_rink(orientation = "vertical", zones = "oz",                   colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +     geom_rink_bin(style = style, binwidth = 2, ...) +     # One shared colour key: fix the limits instead of using each plot's range     scale_fill_rink(name = "Mean xG", limits = c(0.02, 0.25)) +     labs(title = paste0('style = "', style, '"')) +     theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 13, family = "mono")) }  heatmap("size") + heatmap("fill", gap = 0.15) + heatmap("alpha") +   plot_layout(guides = "collect") +   plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

title: Ice Hockey Rinks and Spatial Heatmaps for ggplot2
text: rink_bin() returns grid data frame, can derive per-cell value plot precomputed = TRUE. team’s shot share minus team’s, diverging scale:
code: cells <- rink_bin(shots, x, y, binwidth = 3, by = team) wide <- merge(   cells[cells$team == "Lakeside", c("x", "y", "n")],   cells[cells$team == "Northfield", c("x", "y", "n")],   by = c("x", "y"), all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_lake", "_north") ) wide[is.na(wide)] <- 0 wide$value <- wide$n_lake / sum(wide$n_lake) - wide$n_north / sum(wide$n_north) wide$n <- wide$n_lake + wide$n_north  ggplot(wide, aes(x, y)) +   annotate_rink(orientation = "vertical", zones = "oz", colour = "grey55") +   geom_rink_bin(precomputed = TRUE, style = "size", diverging = TRUE, binwidth = 3) +   scale_fill_rink_diverging(name = "Shot share", labels = c("Northfield", "Even", "Lakeside")) +   labs(title = "Where each team shoots from more")

title: Add a hockey rink to a ggplot — annotate_rink
text: colour Colour rink markings. fill Colour ice. dimensions Rink dimensions draw, e.g. IIHF (default) NHL; see rink_dims rink_dimensions(). orientation "horizontal" (default) "vertical" (right-hand end, offensive zone, top). zones zones show, subset c("dz", "nz", "oz") (default three); "oz" high-x end. Sets xlim , e.g. c("dz", "nz") crops defensive neutral zones. Ignored xlim given. xlim, ylim Optional plot limits rink coordinates, crop hand. xlim overrides zones; ylim defaults full width plus margin. margin Space (rink units) added beyond end side boards. zone_margin Space added beyond blue line zones stops , crop runs little past line instead ending . linewidth Multiplier rink line widths. ggplot2 line widths absolute (mm page), reduce small heavily faceted rinks. details TRUE, draw faceoff hash marks dot cut-outs. slot TRUE, shade offensive-zone slot. slot_colour, slot_fill, slot_alpha, slot_linewidth Slot styling. logos Optional logos place ice, named list centre, left right (centre ice, just inside blue line). entry path PNG file image already memory (array returned png::readPNG(), matrix colours raster). Reading PNG files needs png package. logos ship gghockey: bring ones rights use. logo_alpha Opacity logos, 0 1. theme TRUE (default), add theme_rink() (, vertical rinks, matching aspect ratio). Set FALSE supply theme.

what: Binned heatmap of events on a rink — geom_rink_bin
title: Binned heatmap of events on a rink — geom_rink_bin
text: Bins events square grid draws one square per cell, coloured mean z aesthetic (e.g. expected goals, per-event value). Squares drawn rink units never exceed binwidth, tile grid without overlapping look identical export size. Add rink annotate_rink(); facet however like.

title: Binned heatmap of events on a rink — geom_rink_bin
code: geom_rink_bin(   mapping = NULL,   data = NULL,   position = "identity",   ...,   style = c("size", "fill", "alpha"),   binwidth = 2.5,   gap = 0,   alpha = NULL,   dimensions = IIHF,   xlim = NULL,   ylim = NULL,   precomputed = FALSE,   scales = TRUE,   diverging = FALSE,   colour = NA,   linewidth = 0,   na.rm = FALSE,   show.legend = NA,   inherit.aes = TRUE )

title: Binned heatmap of events on a rink — geom_rink_bin
text: mapping Aesthetic mapping, usually aes(x, y, z) (often set ggplot() call), z averaged within cell. fill, size alpha supplied style; anything map overrides . precomputed = TRUE, data needs value n columns (returned rink_bin()). data, position, na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes Standard ggplot2 layer arguments. ... arguments passed ggplot2::layer(). style One "size", "fill" "alpha" (see Details). binwidth Cell size, rink units. Also largest square side. gap "fill" "alpha", gap squares rink units (square side binwidth - gap). alpha Constant square alpha "size" "fill" (default 0.9). Ignored "alpha", alpha mapped. dimensions Rink dimensions (e.g. IIHF, NHL) set binning bounds, events behind boards snap last -rink cell. Pass rink drawing, NULL bin without bounds. Ignored xlim / ylim given, precomputed = TRUE. xlim, ylim Optional binning bounds rink coordinates. precomputed TRUE, skip binning draw cells supplied, e.g. values derived rink_bin(). scales TRUE (default), also return matching scales style: scale_fill_rink() (scale_fill_rink_diverging() diverging = TRUE) plus scale_size_rink() "size" scale_alpha_rink() "alpha". Set FALSE add . diverging Use diverging fill scale, maps differences centred 0 (e.g. player minus league average). colour, linewidth Square border colour width. default draws border; use e.g. colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3 gridlines.

title: Binned heatmap of events on a rink — geom_rink_bin
text: ggplot2 layer, list layer scales.

title: Binned heatmap of events on a rink — geom_rink_bin
text: Three ready-made styles cover common maps; pick one style: "size" Square size encodes event count (area proportional frequency), fill mean value. "fill" Constant-size squares fill cell (leave gap thin gridlines); fill encodes mean value. "alpha" Constant-size squares whose alpha encodes event count fill mean value. Without z aesthetic value average; map fill after_stat(count) pure frequency map (see examples).

title: Binned heatmap of events on a rink — geom_rink_bin
code: library(ggplot2)  base <- ggplot(shots, aes(x, y, z = xg)) +   annotate_rink(orientation = "vertical", zones = "oz",                 colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5)  base + geom_rink_bin(style = "size", binwidth = 2)  base + geom_rink_bin(style = "fill", binwidth = 2, gap = 0.1)  base + geom_rink_bin(style = "alpha", binwidth = 2)   # Frequency only: fill by count, your own scale base +   geom_rink_bin(aes(fill = after_stat(count)), style = "fill",                 binwidth = 2, scales = FALSE) +   scale_fill_rink(name = "Shots", labels = NULL)

title: Scales for rink heatmaps — scale_rink
text: Matched scales geom_rink_bin() styles: scale_fill_rink() Sequential fill cell mean, labelled Low / High ends default. Used every style. scale_fill_rink_diverging() Diverging fill centred 0, maps differences. Limits symmetric around 0 (data unless pass limits), 0 sits neutral midpoint. scale_size_rink() Event-count size scale style = "size". Square sides set rink units fraction binwidth, largest square fills cell smallest stays legible. scale_alpha_rink() Event-count alpha scale style = "alpha".

title: Scales for rink heatmaps — scale_rink
code: scale_fill_rink(   name = "Value",   palette = "Viridis",   limits = NULL,   breaks = function(lims) lims,   labels = c("Low", "High"),   ... )  scale_fill_rink_diverging(   name = "Difference",   palette = "Blue-Red 3",   limits = NULL,   breaks = function(lims) c(lims[1], 0, lims[2]),   labels = c("Below", "0", "Above"),   ... )  scale_size_rink(   name = "Count",   binwidth = 2.5,   frac = c(0.4, 1),   square_colour = "#143F84",   ... )  scale_alpha_rink(   name = "Count",   range = c(0.15, 1),   square_colour = "#143F84",   ... )

title: Scales for rink heatmaps — scale_rink
text: name Legend title. palette grDevices::hcl.colors() palette name (see grDevices::hcl.pals()), e.g. "Viridis", "Mako" "Rocket" sequential scale "Blue-Red 3", "Vik" "Purple-Green" diverging one; vector colours. limits Fill limits. scale_fill_rink_diverging(), NULL derives symmetric limits c(-, ) data. breaks, labels Passed underlying scale. defaults label ends bar (0 diverging scale); use e.g. breaks = waiver(), labels = waiver() numeric labels. ... Passed underlying ggplot2 scale. binwidth binwidth given geom_rink_bin(). Square sides range frac * binwidth. frac Smallest largest square side, fraction binwidth. largest capped 1 (one full cell) squares never overlap. square_colour Fill colour legend squares. range Smallest largest alpha.
